card.title: Not That Subject
card.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've booked your car into that garage with the café. Shall we have breakfast there?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does my car need a garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their full breakfast includes unlimited toast. You always say that's important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll look at the car while you order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's take the bus. Then we can both have the breakfast cocktails.

mechanism: A prevents discussion or inspection of the car's problem by repeatedly redirecting to breakfast attractions.
confusable: Unlike changing topics arbitrarily, each diversion must block the same approaching car question.
comparison: D14-a changes transport to prevent inspection; D14-b delays a rent inquiry by controlling a photograph and phone.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
